code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
    if toks:
        n = toks[0]
        arr = toks[1:1+n]
        evens = [x for x in arr if x % 2 == 0]
        odds = [x for x in arr if x % 2 != 0]
        res = []
        for i in range(min(len(evens), len(odds))):
            res.append(str(evens[i]))
            res.append(str(odds[i]))
        print(" ".join(res))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
